prompts.prompt:
AUTOMATION_CONTRACT

Before other steps: read `.state/AUTOMATION_CONTRACT.md` on the target repo. Do not use ProjectBrain MCP.

Monthly Agentic AI Field Card judgment for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/agentic-ai-field-card (branch main).

Follow docs/weekly-refresh-prompt.md exactly (fail-closed). That playbook is still named weekly-refresh-prompt.md on the source repo until it is renamed; this run is monthly.

Hard rules:
- Public H1 stays "Agentic AI is a loop, not a menu". Do not revert to stack; analytics owns stack.
- Discovery alone is not enough — every run must end with an explicit update OR no HTML change decision in the PR ## Summary (include Decision: update|no-change).
- Do not merge. Do not force-push main. The 1st-of-month 18:00 review agent publishes or keeps the previous card.
- Never invent docs URLs.
- Framework picker ≤ 7 rows; swap by constraint, not hype. Practice hits cannot earn a picker row.
- Public stamp is monthly (Reviewed <month> · Next: <next month>), not "week of".
- Practice section (engineering feeds + practiceQueries web search) can earn at most two decision-table rows or an anti-pattern, and only for a job the card does not already decide.

Steps:
1. Prefer open branch chore/monthly-refresh-YYYY-MM for this calendar month; else create/update from main. Do not open chore/weekly-refresh-*.
2. Run npm run discover; read data/discovery-report.md (framework candidates and Practice) and index.html.
3. Decide update vs no-change; write ## Summary either way, including which practice hits were adopted or deferred.
4. If updating index.html: apply picker/table rules; bump version; fix Changed line.
5. Run node scripts/check-links.mjs on any URLs you touched.
6. Update data/watchlist.json onCard flags as needed.
7. Record every practice.hits URL in data/practice-seen.json and run node scripts/check-practice-seen.mjs.
8. Commit/push to the monthly PR only.
9. Rewrite PR body with ## Summary and ## Card preview.
10. Stop. Do not notify Slack. Do not merge.

Done when discovery ran, Summary has the decision, practice-seen check exits 0, link check is clean if HTML changed, and the PR is open for the 18:00 review agent.
